current_schedule.text_as_printed: Ministries of the government.

A person, corporation, commission, board, bureau or authority who is or the majority of the members of which are, or the majority of the members of the board of management or board of directors of which are, (a) appointed by an Act, minister, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, (b) in the discharge of their duties, public officers or servants of the government, or (c) responsible to the government.
A corporation the ownership of which or a majority of the shares of which is vested in the government.
Municipalities.
Regional districts.
The Islands Trust established under the Islands Trust Act .
Improvement districts as defined in the Local Government Act .
[Repealed 2014-1-12.]
Boards, committees, commissions or similar bodies established under the Community Charter , the Local Government Act or the Vancouver Charter .
The Resort Municipality of Whistler and the Whistler Resort Association.
A local trust committee, the Trust Council, the Islands Trust Conservancy and the executive committee and persons to whom their powers are delegated under the Islands Trust Act .
Library boards as defined in the Library Act .
The Cultus Lake Park Board.
A greater board as defined in the Community Charter .
Water users' communities as defined in section 1 (1) of the Water Users' Communities Act .
Development districts, the comptroller and water managers under the Water Sustainability Act .

The commissioners of a district defined in section 58 of the Drainage, Ditch and Dike Act and an engineer, commissioner, inspector of dikes, land settlement board, municipality or regional district acting under that Act.
The British Columbia Diking Authority and a diking authority under the Dike Maintenance Act .
The Okanagan Kootenay Sterile Insect Release Board.
Regional transit commissions established under the British Columbia Transit Act .

A corporation (a) more than 50% of the issued voting shares of which are owned by one or more of the authorities listed in section 4 to 19 or this section, or (b) that is controlled by one or more of the authorities listed in section 4 to 19 and, for the purposes of ascertaining control, a corporation is controlled by one or more of these authorities if a majority of the members of the corporation or of its board of directors or board of management consists of either or both of the following: (i) persons appointed as members by the authorities; (ii) officers or employees of an authority acting as such.
Schools and boards as defined in the School Act .
Francophone education authorities as defined in the School Act and francophone schools operated by francophone education authorities.
Universities as defined in the University Act .
The University of Northern British Columbia.
The Thompson Rivers University.
Royal Roads University.
Institutions as defined in the College and Institute Act .
Hospitals and boards of management of hospitals as defined in the Hospital Act .
Governing bodies of professional and occupational associations that are established or continued by an Act.
Regional Health Boards established under the Health Authorities Act .
Regional Hospital Districts under the Hospital District Act .
The South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority continued under the South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority Act .
The Business Practices and Consumer Protection Authority established under the Business Practices and Consumer Protection Authority Act .
The Municipal Pension Board of Trustees.
The Teachers' Pension Board of Trustees.
The Public Service Pension Board of Trustees.
The College Pension Board of Trustees.
The British Columbia Safety Authority established under the Safety Authority Act .
The Land Title and Survey Authority established under the Land Title and Survey Authority Act .

history_events.subject: Office of the Ombudsman
history_events.detail: The anniversary order records the office opening on 1 October 1979; this is not a substitute for the original commencement proclamation.

history_events.subject: Schools and school boards
history_events.locator: Historical note to Schedule item 7; B.C. Reg. 374/92

history_events.subject: Government-owned corporations; universities; colleges; hospitals
history_events.locator: Historical note, Schedule items 3 and 8–10; B.C. Reg. 114/93
history_events.detail: These portions of the Schedule were brought into force. Some bodies may already have qualified under the appointment/responsibility class; do not equate a class commencement with every body’s first-ever coverage.

history_events.subject: Statutory professional and occupational governing bodies
history_events.locator: Historical note, Schedule item 11; B.C. Reg. 338/93
history_events.detail: Coverage added by class rather than a list of college brand names.

history_events.subject: Regional health boards and community health councils
history_events.detail: The contemporary consolidation includes both classes; exact deposit/effective day has not been recovered.

history_events.subject: Municipalities, regional districts and Islands Trust
history_events.detail: Schedule items 4–6 are brought into force. Stamp visually checked. The associated B.C. Reg. 264/95 deposit record remains to be checked; approval is not silently substituted for deposit.

history_events.subject: Additional local public bodies, UNBC and regional hospital districts
history_events.detail: Adds improvement districts; local boards; Whistler and its association; Islands Trust components; libraries; regional parks/Cultus Lake; greater boards; water and dyking bodies; Okanagan Kootenay Sterile Insect Release Board; regional transit commissions; controlled local corporations; UNBC; regional hospital districts.

history_events.subject: Royal Roads University
history_events.detail: Adds Royal Roads University as Schedule item 8.2. Approval stamp visually checked; deposit day not independently recovered.

history_events.subject: Community health councils
history_events.detail: The words referring to councils are removed; this is a Schedule cleanup date, not each council’s dissolution date.

history_events.subject: Business Practices and Consumer Protection Authority
Municipal, Teachers’, Public Service and College Pension Boards of Trustees
history_events.detail: Four pension boards added; do not substitute BC Pension Corporation or BCI.

history_events.subject: Land Title and Survey Authority
history_events.detail: Named authority added after its corporate start.

history_events.subject: South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority
history_events.detail: Re-enacts the former Greater Vancouver Transportation Authority entry under the new name; not a first-coverage finding.

specific_exceptions.subject: B.C. Ferry Authority and converted British Columbia Ferry Corporation / BC Ferry Services
specific_exceptions.rule: Ombudsperson Act expressly does not apply. FOIPPA designation and ferry-regulator complaints remain separate questions.

specific_exceptions.subject: Matters under the Police Act and its regulations
specific_exceptions.rule: Ombudsperson Act does not apply to this Act or its regulations. Do not infer an ordinary Ombudsperson route from a police-related body’s public status.

specific_exceptions.subject: Information and Privacy Commissioner
specific_exceptions.rule: Ombudsperson investigation of matters arising under FOIPPA requires the Commissioner’s consent.

general_limits.rule: Administrative acts; statutory exclusions and available appeal/review remedies must be examined. Coverage is not an entitlement to reversal of a merits decision.
Recommendations, responses, reports to Cabinet/Assembly and notice to complainants are distinct edges; the Ombudsperson does not become the investigated body’s manager.

coverage_start_caution: The first date an individual institution satisfies an existing class can differ from the date a named entry was added. No undated appointment class is backfilled to incorporation.
